exposure: Surgical repair of uterine cesarean scar defects by minilaparotomy
cohort: Seven nonpregnant women with a history of cesarean section and a large uterine scar defect were enrolled.
finding: Surgical repair of uterine cesarean scar defects is effective in increasing residual myometrial thickness, decreasing the depth of the scar, and resolving symptoms like postmenstrual spotting and abdominal pain.
